title: Add `key` to all components.
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

给每一个组件[st.xxx]添加key，增加UI的可定制性
Add key to each component [ st.xxx ] to increase the customizability of the UI.

e.g. st.columns,

### Why?

increase the customizability of the UI.

### How?

add key to components

### Additional Context

_No response_

comments.body:
**To help Streamlit prioritize this feature, react with a 👍 (thumbs up emoji) to the initial post.**

Your vote helps us identify which enhancements matter most to our users.

![Views](https://api.views-badge.org/badge/st-issue-11779)

been using stylable_container from extras to achieve that. Would be nice to have a native way to identify elements using CSS as opposed to the hacky way that the extra component identifies said stylable container.

Imagine if this:

.stVerticalBlock:has(> div.element-container > div.stMarkdown > div[data-testid="stMarkdownContainer"] > p > span.stylable_container)

becomes this:

.stylable_container

This feature would also be very handy for automated testing; Testers at my company asked to add keys so they can identify elements in a stable matter, which I now must do by putting everything inside containers (those do have a key parameter).
